products.title: Frizzante Pét-Nat
products.description: A cloudy, crown-capped sparkler finished in the bottle the old way — one fermentation, no dosage, nothing added. Bone-dry and gently fizzy, with green apple, lemon pith and a little bready funk. The bottle we open first, every time.
products.seoTitle: Frizzante Pét-Nat — dry sparkling natural wine | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A bone-dry, gently fizzy pét-nat finished in the bottle — green apple, lemon pith, a little bready funk.

images.alt: A crown-capped bottle of cloudy pét-nat sparkling wine

products.title: Amber Hours Skin-Contact
products.description: White grapes left on their skins for two weeks, the way orange wine has been made for millennia. Deep amber, lightly tannic and properly savoury — dried apricot, orange peel, black tea and a grippy, moreish finish. Treat it like a light red.
products.seoTitle: Amber Hours Skin-Contact — orange wine | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A properly savoury skin-contact orange wine — dried apricot, orange peel, black tea and a grippy finish.

images.alt: A bottle of amber skin-contact orange wine

products.title: Cold Press Chillable Red
products.description: A light, bright red built to go in the fridge — low tannin, high glee. Crunchy red cherry, cranberry and a peppery lift, with a whole-bunch juiciness that begs for a half-hour chill. Pizza wine, picnic wine, Tuesday wine.
products.seoTitle: Cold Press Chillable Red — light natural red | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A light, low-tannin red built for the fridge — crunchy red cherry, cranberry and a peppery lift.

images.alt: A bottle of bright, chillable red wine

products.title: Slate & Stone White
products.description: A taut, mineral white from old vines on poor soil — the kind that gives more flavour and less crop. Bone-dry and saline, with green apple, white flowers and a wet-stone snap that runs right through the finish. Oysters would be thrilled.
products.seoTitle: Slate & Stone White — mineral natural white | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A taut, saline mineral white — green apple, white flowers and a wet-stone snap. Bone-dry.

images.alt: A bottle of pale mineral white wine

products.title: Blush Riot Rosé
products.description: A dry, pale rosé with none of the sugary softness the colour gets blamed for. Wild strawberry, pink grapefruit and a herbal, savoury edge, with real texture underneath. The house rosé from the first warm day to the last.
products.seoTitle: Blush Riot Rosé — dry natural rosé | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A dry, pale rosé with real texture — wild strawberry, pink grapefruit and a savoury, herbal edge.

images.alt: A bottle of dry pale rosé

products.title: House Pour Everyday Red
products.description: The bottle we reach for on a weeknight and the one we recommend most. A medium red with dark cherry, plum and a little wild herb, soft enough to drink on its own and structured enough to sit with dinner. Great value, honestly farmed.
products.seoTitle: House Pour Everyday Red — natural red wine | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A soft, structured everyday red — dark cherry, plum and a little wild herb. Great value, honestly farmed.

images.alt: A bottle of easy everyday red wine

products.title: Free Spirit Non-Alc Sparkling
products.description: A grown-up alcohol-free sparkling for the nights you are not drinking but still want something in the good glass. Gently fizzy and properly dry, with white peach, elderflower and a citrus snap — none of the cloying sweetness most non-alc falls into.
products.seoTitle: Free Spirit Non-Alc Sparkling — alcohol-free wine | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A grown-up alcohol-free sparkling — dry, gently fizzy, white peach and elderflower. No cloying sweetness.

images.alt: A bottle of non-alcoholic sparkling wine on ice

products.title: Big Night Magnum
products.description: A magnum of our juicy house red — the same honest bottle, at twice the size and built for a full table. There is something about pulling the cork on a big format that turns a dinner into an occasion; wine keeps better and ages slower in a magnum, too.
products.seoTitle: Big Night Magnum — 1.5L natural red wine | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A 1.5L magnum of our juicy house red — built for a full table and a real occasion.

images.alt: A magnum bottle of red wine on a table

products.title: The Weeknight Six
products.description: Six bottles, our pick, at a better price than buying them one by one — the easiest way to fill the rack with low-intervention wine you will actually finish. Choose a mix of colours, all reds, or all whites and oranges; we swap the line-up every month.
products.seoTitle: The Weeknight Six — mixed natural wine case | Sediment
products.seoDescription: A curated six-bottle case of low-intervention wine at a better price — mixed, all red, or all white and orange.
